_about: 古七's boards (h11; the per-回 plan 2026-10-15, Wave 2 D): each the book's own action where its scene stands, every one skippable once stuck (the page's 算了，往下走), and each pays what the plan names — 修为 for cultivation (禹步, 定风), 灵石 / a thing for the rest (认方 a 聚气丹, 闻焦 and 芦苇 灵石). The two fights (灵草谷's 犰狳, 崖顶's 秦雁) are scene duels on their exits, paid there.
_economy: Pay declared here for the economy model (tools/balance.mjs reads tasks/*.json): the 修为 is +10 over 古七 from boards (jiuge-yubu 5, furnace-ding 5; 随叶 and 顺风溜's 5 each went with the 调息 cut 2026-10-20, told), +30 the 犰狳 (09-lingcao/fight, scene table) and +30 the 秦雁 bout (09-futian/spar, trial table, paid after the 七层 rise); 灵石 +2 (yishui-reed; year-smell's +3 went with its cut 2026-10-19), +20 (犰狳), +20 (秦雁); items: qi-pill (furnace-recipe), huochai-jian and shunfeng-liu (on the ways on). The three rises — 五层 (09-furnace/fire, and 09-year/futian as a catch-up), 六层 (09-yishui/night), 七层 (09-futian/spar, the 秦雁 bout's way on) — each wait on the 阶段任务: 圆满 of the layer held (caps.hui.h11.gates: [{layer 4, 09-furnace, [fire]}, {layer 4, 09-year, [futian]}, {layer 5, 09-yishui, [night]}, {layer 6, 09-futian, [spar]}]).

title.en: The Step of Yu · Nine squares

tasks._reward: 修为 5, and the mark `yubu` either way (he walked it) — 古九's 量河滩 board reads it.

tasks._cut: Off 09-furnace 2026-10-19 (the standing rule Hanli approved 10-19: a memory puzzle, button-only, fits no kit): the passage whole again (story_after merged), 定风 the scene's one board; its 聚气丹 is the way on's (09-furnace/fire grant). `cut` lets a save holding it offered let it go on load (state.mjs fitWorld); row and module stay in the 游戏厅.

title.en: Reading the recipes · Three of them

done_line.en: Three recipes, kept in his belly.

tasks._reward: A 聚气丹 (qi-pill) — the plan's: a lesson, not cultivation.

tasks._shouqiang: 2026-10-20 (the 调息 cut, Hanli: 「调息感觉太多了」 → 「可以」): 09-furnace's board in the same slot is 守墙关's story level `yaoyuan-spring` (levels/shouqiang.json, `story: "09-furnace"` — 兽潮 never serves it, the 游戏厅 keeps it off the ladder): spring, the herb garden opens, the 巡夜令 still his (「园里少一株，戒律堂头一个问你」); 野猪 and 狰 only. Was 气走经脉 · 定风 (10-19). Id and pay kept; the marks ding-still · ding-shaky (read by no line) went with the level.

how.zh: 开春，药园开了园。点一张符，再点畦里一格布下去：聚灵阵攒灵气，剑符守一畦，土墙垫在狰的前头。一株也别丢。
how.en: Spring, and the herb garden is open. Tap a talisman, then a patch of bed, to set it: spirit arrays for qi, sword talismans to hold a bed, an earth wall in front of the zheng. Lose not one herb.

done_line.en: Dawn, and not one herb missing.

tasks._cut: Off 09-year 2026-10-19 (Hanli: 「时机, 调息不好玩的可以删掉或者改进」): the passage whole again (story_after merged), 伏天 needs only 清明; the task, row and module stay for the 游戏厅, and `cut` lets a save holding it offered let it go on load (state.mjs fitWorld).

done_line.zh: 「丹师，这个……是不是就是丹焦的味儿？」
done_line.en: "Pill-master, this... is this the smell of a pill scorching?"

tasks._reward: 灵石 +3 — the 「丹房 · 看丹炉」 tablet's work (周衡: 看炉，记功).

tasks._zhazhai: 2026-10-20 (Hanli: 「其他投掷类都用砸寨的不同关卡代替」): a level of 砸寨, the throw kit (tools/zhazhai/src/data/throws.ts `yishui-reed`); was the 射鹿-board row `luwing`, deleted. `grades`: the game's stars → the marks (★★–★★★ still, ★ hasty).

how.zh: 往后拉，松手放剑，越过浮木落到它背上；飞行中点一下，剑直冲出去。等它吸气，翅膀根翻开的那一霎。
how.en: Pull back and let go: over the driftwood, onto its back; tap in flight and the sword flies straight. Wait for its breath: the instant the wing root opens.

done_line.zh: 它叫了一声，翅膀张了一半，塌了下去。
done_line.en: It bellowed; the wings half opened and collapsed.

tasks._reward: 灵石 +2 — the book's split of the 四块 (「阿禾一块，孙二狗一块，他两块」); the hide and membrane are told (no item rows).
